sentences.text: A frequency filter is a circuit designed to pass signals with desired frequencies while attenuating unwanted frequencies.
A Low-Pass Filter passes low frequencies from DC up to a cutoff frequency fc, and blocks high frequencies.
A High-Pass Filter blocks DC and low frequencies while passing high frequencies.
The cutoff frequency fc (the -3dB point) for a simple RC filter is: fc = 1 / (2 pi R C).
At the cutoff frequency, the output power drops to exactly 50% of the input power (a 3 decibel drop).
